definitions: To draw (fluid) by suction from a body cavity, part, or vessel.
To pronounce (a stop, an affricate, or a fricative) with an accompanying puff of air.
To suck food or fluid into the lungs accidentally.
examples: The doctor will aspirate the fluid from the joint.
Many English speakers aspirate the 'p' in 'pin'.
Be careful not to aspirate during the procedure.
